description:
Tests the target, takes the backup lock and answers with the move id. The steps (maintenance, safety backup, schema, copy, verify, switch) run in the background: changes are refused while it runs, and the backend restarts on the new database at the end. Follow it with GET /database/move. A move to SQLite needs only the engine and creates a new file. 409 when a move, backup or restore runs or the connection comes from the DB_* environment variables. Errors carry a database.error.<code> message id (env-locked, move-running, not-empty when the new SQLite file exists already, and the target test codes: invalid-target, connect, timeout, version, not-empty, permission, same-database) or backup.error.busy.
Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)

id.description: The move id, the same as in GET /database/move.
